prover: Harmonic Aristotle (proofs re-checked by the Lean kernel)

properties.plain: A healthy loan can never be liquidated.
properties.assumptions: Integer (uint256) model of NightshiftVault; overflow reverts in Solidity 0.8.

properties.plain: The Vault's health check means exactly: debt is no more than collateral value times the liquidation LTV.
properties.assumptions: Integer model; floor division as in Solidity.

properties.plain: A price rise never makes a healthy loan unhealthy.
properties.assumptions: Integer model.

properties.plain: Adding collateral never makes a healthy loan unhealthy.
properties.assumptions: Integer model.

properties.plain: Repaying debt never makes a healthy loan unhealthy.
properties.assumptions: Integer model.

properties.plain: The Vault always rounds in the protocol's favour: a loan it calls healthy is healthy in exact arithmetic too.
properties.assumptions: Integer model.

properties.plain: Liquidation bonuses are capped at 15%.
properties.assumptions: LLTV at most 100%.

properties.plain: Anything you can borrow within the Nightshift limit is healthy at that same price.
properties.assumptions: Integer model; same oracle price at borrow time.

properties.plain: The Guardian's sale amount is never negative.
properties.assumptions: Real-number model; slippage below 100%; position solvent after slippage.

properties.plain: The Guardian never sells more collateral than you have.
properties.assumptions: Real-number model; slippage below 100%; position solvent after slippage.

properties.plain: When the Guardian acts, it restores your loan exactly to your target health.
properties.assumptions: Real-number model (the contract rounds the sale down, so on-chain it can land a hair below target); slippage below 100%; position solvent after slippage.

properties.plain: The Guardian never sells more than it needs to.
properties.assumptions: Real-number model; slippage below 100%; position solvent after slippage.

properties.plain: If selling can't help, the Guardian won't sell. It alerts you instead.
properties.assumptions: Real-number model; enforced in the contract, the keeper and the paper Guardian.

properties.plain: The Guardian only acts on loans that can still be saved by selling.
properties.assumptions: Real-number model; LLTV below 1 − slippage (true for every Nightshift market).

properties.plain: The fair value always stays between the lowest and highest market signal.
properties.assumptions: Weights non-negative and summing to 1 (proven by O1a).

properties.plain: The Oracle's signal weights are never negative and always add up to 100%.
properties.assumptions: Real-number model of the normalisation in computeQuote.

properties.plain: Learning from past accuracy can never produce a negative weight.
properties.assumptions: Real-number model of learnWeights.

properties.plain: With the signals' agreement unchanged, confidence never rises while the market stays closed.
properties.assumptions: Dispersion held fixed; confidence also depends on how much the signals agree, which can change.

properties.plain: More disagreement between the signals never raises confidence.
properties.assumptions: Real-number model before rounding.

properties.plain: Confidence always stays between 35 and 98.
properties.assumptions: Real-number model before rounding (rounding keeps the bounds).

properties.plain: Cloak proofs can't be faked through number overflow.
properties.assumptions: Circuit range checks of 64, 40 and 14 bits; BN254 field.

properties.plain: The debt side of the Cloak comparison also stays inside its safe range.
properties.assumptions: Debt range check of 64 bits; GreaterThan(120).

properties.plain: Inside the circuit's range, field arithmetic equals ordinary arithmetic.
properties.assumptions: Values below the field modulus.

properties.plain: A Cloak proof made from rounded numbers still proves the real loan is solvent.
properties.assumptions: Collateral rounded down and debt rounded up before proving (as the app now does).
